modmenu.descriptionTranslation.display_m: Optimizes item_display and block_display rendering with model caching, distance limits, off-screen culling, and optional occlusion through Entity Culling.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.display_model: Optimizes item_display and block_display rendering with model caching, distance limits, off-screen culling, and optional occlusion through Entity Culling.
display_model_optimizer.config.title: Display Model Optimizer — Settings
display_model_optimizer.option.enabled.t: Enable rendering optimization and the item_display and block_display distance limit.
display_model_optimizer.option.cache_mod: Prepare identical block_display models once per frame.
display_model_optimizer.option.occlusion: Uses the installed Entity Culling mod. Supplies item_display and block_display model bounds so fully occluded decorations can be hidden behind opaque blocks. Glass follows Entity Culling's transparency rules. Unknown bounds retain visibility.
display_model_optimizer.config.ec_missin: Entity Culling is required for occlusion
0–1024 blocks, default: 18. 0 keeps the original distance. For example, 18 hides item_display and block_display beyond 18 blocks; they appear as you approach. Text displays retain their original range.
display_model_optimizer.option.model_lim: 0–16384 model combinations. Default: 1024. Limits the per-frame model cache and persistent geometry cache separately. 0 disables both.
display_model_optimizer.option.minimum_s: 0–65536 states. Default: 32. Small groups retain the original lookup.
display_model_optimizer.option.verify_ev: 0–1048576 lookups. Default: 256. 0 disables sampled draw-index verification.
display_model_optimizer.config.invalid: Check values on all settings tabs
display_model_optimizer.config.save_fail: Could not save. Details are in the log
display_model_optimizer.config.session_d: Verification disabled optimization. Restart the game
display_model_optimizer.about.author: Author: %s
display_model_optimizer.option.offscreen: Use actual model bounds to skip item_display and block_display outside the camera view. Works without Entity Culling. Unknown or animated model bounds remain visible.
display_model_optimizer.option.cache_geo: Reuse converted block_display geometry across frames. Requires Fabric Renderer API 17.0.16+. Models without a geometry key use normal preparation. Clear on resource reload, world or graphics changes.
